title: How Shorts money works
subtitle: The ad pool, the 45%, and what pays sooner
sections: Ads between Shorts go into a pool.
Creators keep 45% of their allocated share.
YouTube Partner Program: 1,000 subscribers + 10M Shorts views in 90 days, or 4,000 public watch hours in 12 months.
From 500 subscribers: fan funding (memberships, Super Thanks) and Shopping, in eligible countries.
